items: The project manager asked ____ consultant to review the cost assumptions before approval.
'Consultant' is singular countable and one additional consultant is meant, so 'another' is required.
The orientation program introduces new hires to company policies and ____ internal resources.
'Internal resources' is plural, so 'other' correctly modifies the noun phrase.
Some customers renewed their subscriptions immediately; ____ waited until the reminder email arrived.
The blank stands alone for additional plural customers, so 'others' is required.
The hotel moved the group to ____ conference hall after an air-conditioning problem developed.
'Conference hall' is singular countable and a different hall is meant, so 'another' is required.
The purchasing policy applies to computers, office supplies, and ____ business equipment.
'Business equipment' is uncountable, so 'other' is the appropriate determiner.
Several employees volunteered for the special project; ____ were assigned regular shifts.
The blank stands alone for additional plural employees, so 'others' is required.
The manager requested ____ estimate because the first one did not include installation costs.
'Estimate' is singular countable and one additional estimate is requested, so 'another' is required.
The website provides manuals, warranty details, and ____ technical information.
'Technical information' is uncountable, so 'other' correctly modifies it.
Some deliveries were postponed by snow, while ____ arrived on schedule.
The blank is a standalone plural pronoun referring to additional deliveries, so 'others' is required.
The interviewer asked ____ question to clarify the applicant's project-management experience.
'Question' is singular countable and an additional question is meant, so 'another' is required.
The annual report summarizes sales results and ____ key performance measures.
'Key performance measures' is plural, so 'other' is required.
A few conference rooms are equipped for video calls; ____ are reserved for in-person meetings.
The blank stands alone for additional plural conference rooms, so 'others' is required.
The mechanic used ____ diagnostic tool when the first device displayed an error.
'Diagnostic tool' is singular countable and a different tool is meant, so 'another' is required.
The policy prohibits sharing passwords or ____ confidential information with unauthorized people.
'Confidential information' is uncountable, so 'other' correctly modifies it.
Some trainees finished the exercise early; ____ needed additional guidance from the instructor.
The blank stands alone for additional plural trainees, so 'others' is required.
The sales manager arranged ____ demonstration for the client who missed the first session.
'Demonstration' is singular countable and one additional demonstration is meant, so 'another' is required.
The inspection covered electrical systems and ____ safety-related equipment.
'Safety-related equipment' is uncountable, so 'other' is required.
Several applicants accepted the employment offer, but ____ are still considering it.
The blank stands alone for additional plural applicants, so 'others' is required.
The office administrator ordered ____ cabinet because the existing files no longer fit in storage.
'Cabinet' is singular countable and one additional cabinet is meant, so 'another' is required.
The workshop addresses time management, communication, and ____ professional skills.
'Professional skills' is plural, so 'other' correctly modifies it.
Some suppliers issue monthly invoices, while ____ bill customers after each shipment.
The blank stands alone for additional plural suppliers, so 'others' is required.
The researcher collected ____ sample after discovering that the first one had been contaminated.
'Sample' is singular countable and one additional sample is collected, so 'another' is required.
The relocation package covers moving expenses and ____ necessary costs.
'Necessary costs' is plural, so 'other' is required.
Several employees prefer flexible starting times; ____ value the option to work remotely.
The blank stands alone for additional plural employees, so 'others' is required.
The customer service team opened ____ case after discovering that the two complaints involved separate orders.
'Case' is singular countable and one additional case is meant, so 'another' is required.
